issues.what: Explanation says the kubelet `--network-plugin` flag was 'deprecated in newer kubelet versions'. In Kubernetes 1.24 the flag was fully removed along with dockershim, not merely deprecated. For the target scope of K8s 1.29+, the flag does not exist at all.
issues.fix: Change 'The `--network-plugin` flag was deprecated in newer kubelet versions.' to 'The `--network-plugin` flag was removed in Kubernetes 1.24 along with dockershim; in 1.29+ the kubelet has no such flag.'
